dedupe_keys.name: a decade of urban fires portuguese events between 2013 and 2022

description: A decade of urban fires: Portuguese events between 2013 and 2022 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Regina Bispo et al. This study describes a dataset containing urban fire events that took place in mainland Portugal between 2013 and 2022. The Regulation n.º3317-A/2018, established by the Portuguese National Emergency and Civil Protection Authority (Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil, ANEPC), defines the Operations Management System (Sistema de Gestão de Operações, SGO). Coverage: national (PT); published in 2023. Formats: Excel. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
